scope: Paper B CBIS-DDSM Mass-Training X-only full-mammogram feature generation

correction.reason: The V1 post-freeze/pre-extraction audit used the source function default 1520x912, whereas the actually materialized and audited local CBIS preprocessing cache fixed its intermediate image size at 384x256. Crop geometry was identical, but the resampling values differed. V2 freezes 384x256 before any model extraction or scientific outcome.

allowed_formal_inputs: the exact 1140 image_id/local_dicom_path pairs in the frozen input manifest
their source DICOM bytes under data/cbis_ddsm_mass_train/full
the frozen local BiomedCLIP visual checkpoint
forbidden_formal_inputs: Mass-Test metadata, pixels, labels, predictions, metrics, or counts
ROI or crop pixels, ROI masks, or mask geometry
pathology, outcome, concept, assessment, subtlety, fold, or identifier values as encoder tensor inputs
the old Paper A feature archive or any old CBIS tensor cache
selection or preprocessing decisions based on any scientific outcome
access_boundary.post_publication_technical_audit: Only after atomic publication, compare image_id and embedding arrays on the predeclared 1006-key overlap with the frozen legacy archive; never use that archive to select, fill, replace, or exclude formal features.

preprocessing.dicom_reader: pydicom pixel_array through the existing audited p2_stagewise.dicom_io._read_single_full_image path; exactly one two-dimensional DICOM per frozen path
preprocessing.border_trim: remove exactly five pixels from each of the four raster borders
preprocessing.photometric_inversion: MONOCHROME1 -> max(pixel)-pixel after border trim; MONOCHROME2 unchanged; every other value fails closed
preprocessing.orientation: preserve native stored pixel-array orientation; no laterality-based flip, rotation, or transpose
preprocessing.intensity: per-view global min-max to [0,255] float followed by np.rint and uint8; zero or non-finite dynamic range fails closed
preprocessing.breast_field_crop: reuse p2_stagewise.dicom_io.breast_crop_indices (Mammo-CLIP ExtractBreast longest non-constant row/column run after <=40 background suppression); image pixels only; crop indices must be nonempty and contiguous
preprocessing.first_resize: single-channel [0,1] tensor to the actually audited local cache size 384x256 with torch bilinear interpolation and align_corners=false
preprocessing.encoder_resize: single-channel tensor from 384x256 to 224x224 with torch bilinear interpolation and align_corners=false, then repeat to RGB
preprocessing.legacy_cache_role: resolution provenance and post-publication technical consistency audit only; never a formal extraction input
preprocessing.source_hash_verification: rehash and require the frozen SHA-256 for every source DICOM before first-pass encoding
preprocessing.per_view_receipt: record image key/path/source hash and bytes, photometric mode, original shape, breast crop bounds, normalized feature norm, and replay difference

model.name: hf-hub:microsoft/BiomedCLIP-PubMedBERT_256-vit_base_patch16_224
model.visual_architecture: timm vit_base_patch16_224 trunk plus frozen visual.head.proj.weight (768 to 512, no bias)

determinism.input_order: lexicographic image_id order frozen in the input manifest
determinism.full_replay: re-preprocess and re-encode all 1140 views in the identical CPU process after the formal pass
determinism.archive_serialization: fixed NPZ member order and 1980-01-01 ZIP timestamps

outputs.coverage: exactly all and only the frozen 1140 image IDs, one row each
outputs.publication: stage complete directory, reload and validate every artifact, then Linux renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE)

readiness_gate: METHOD_COMPARISON_READY only after atomic output reload proves exact 1140/1140 keys, float32 (1140,512), finiteness, L2 norms, full deterministic replay, all frozen hashes, and the post-publication 1006-key technical overlap audit passes without becoming a formal input
